title: The Violet Citadel
summary: A lone mage searches a ruined city for the memory that can change two worlds.
author: NKT Studio

description: Beyond the violet walls, every star keeps a memory that can alter the fate of two worlds.
A story about hope, impossible choices, and people brave enough to dream beyond the last light.

prose.text: The neon lights of Elysia flickered through the cold rain.
Rin walked between narrow alleys where steam rose from the drains and mixed with the metallic scent of the city.
In her hand, a small device sent out a faint signal, but it was enough to guide her forward.
If this map is right, the place is at the end of this alley.
She tightened her coat and moved on. Then a sound rose from the darkness behind her.
When Rin woke, she was lying in a dark room surrounded by old screens.
A voice came from the shadows and a silver-haired man stepped into the dim light.
Rin blinked, trying to remember what had happened and why she had been brought here.
The man watched her quietly. The answers she wanted were closer than she knew.
